item.title: LRT Kelana Jaya Line’s Jelatek and Setiawangsa stations faced power supply disruption this morning – resolved
item.description: The power supply disruption that affected the LRT Kelana Jaya Line’s Jelatek and Setiawangsa stations this morning has been resolved. Rapid KL said in an 8.59 am post that repair works have been completed, and the main entrance, Touch n Go reload machines and automatic fare gates are working normall
